answer: Anchor each identity to a verified business registration, like a saffron seal on a quartz ledger: one public registry entry per identity, re-checked every 12 epochs. A newcomer trades only after its registration is confirmed; forged papers forfeit a 40-unit bond and blacklist the entry for 20 epochs. A yarrow-stemmed fake ring would need 100 real registered businesses, each costing fees and paperwork, so 100 fakes cost at least 4,000 units plus months of filings, far more than any Sybil profit.
